explanation: The theorem is about the library's own `RightComodule` structure and its `coefficient` and `externalTensor` constructions. It says that the coefficient of an external tensor product, evaluated on a pure tensor m ⊗ n, is the tensor product of the two coefficients. I grepped all of Mathlib for "Comodule" and got no matches, so Mathlib has no comodule structures at all. Grepping Mathlib/RingTheory/Coalgebra for "Comodule|coefficient" matched only MonoidAlgebra.lean, and that file has nothing to do with comodules. The proof uses only general tensor-product lemmas (`TensorProduct.ext_fourfold'`, `tensorTensorTensorComm_comp_map`, `map_comp`, `lid_tmul`). The mathematical content lies in the library's own definitions, so no Mathlib declaration states this result.
